Definition: adverb from G2451; Judaïcally or in a manner resembling a Judæan:--as do the Jews.
BiblicalUsage: As do the Jews is the phrase Paul throws at Peter in Antioch, and it stings because it is true. In Galatians 2:14 Paul says to Peter before them all, if thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the rebuke is the gospel itself: Peter was living like a Gentile until the men from James came, and Paul would not let him put the yoke back on.
